data.description: Wolves native to the cold, northern mountains of the continent.
data.name: Arctic Wolf

data.description: Renowned hunter and mariner among the Nordman. Lives in the frozen north.
data.name: Hreidmar

data.description: Raised from birth by the revered caste of dragon trainers these beasts are trained to be used as mounts by the feared Dragonriders.
data.name: Rune Dragon

data.description: A member of an elite force. Greatly respected among Runics. Universally feared.
data.name: Runic Dragonrider

data.description: This elite fighting unit represents two coordinated individuals. The Dragonrider is able to attack with his blade while the dragon employs it's claws, fangs and magic.
data.name: Mounted Dragonrider

data.description: Light cavalry armed with sword and net. Drawn from the ranks of the non Rune-chosen. A bitter rivalry exists between the light and the heavy horse.
data.name: Runic Light Horse

data.description: Heavily armed cavalry. Drawn from the ranks of the Rune-chosen. As deadly as they are arrogant.
data.name: Runic Heavy Horse

data.description: Slaine is an accomplished captain of the Runic Heavy Horse. Popular with his own troops he is hated and feared by the other wings of the Runic army.
data.name: Slaine

data.description: Light cavalry armed with sword and net. Drawn from the ranks of the non Rune-chosen. A bitter rivalry exists between the light and the heavy horse.
data.name: Runic Light Horse

data.description: Former Runic veteran - now on the run.
data.name: Reismar

data.description: So named because of the test of loyalty required of him to please his God. Flayt tracked down and killed his every known relative, children included.
data.name: Flayt the Kinless

data.description: Barnagh has travelled far from his native Calvert over the sea to the South, irresistably compelled by the drawing power of something beyond his comprehension.
data.name: Barnagh of Calvert

data.description: A mighty orc general. His implacable campaigns against the Runic invaders won him the respect of orcs and a huge bounty on his head from the Runics.
data.name: Mojril Redemon

data.description: It is rumoured that these are protectors given by evil deities to their disciples. Granted the dubious gift of unlife they serve whatever master they are given to.
data.name: Deoc Garde

data.description: High Prelate of the Gray God, whose name cannot be uttered.
data.name: Gremyr the High Prelate

data.description: As the wicked of the land gradually found themselves compelled to wander to Skullkeep, those with some martial ability joined the ranks of the Defenders. Fanatical warriors.
data.name: Defender of the Faith

data.description: Whats the message?
data.name: Messenger

data.description: A powerful dragon that tends to live in sandy areas. Its diet consists mostly of crabs and shellfish but it will happily eat adventurers. Thankfully it doesn't use magic.
data.name: Sand Wyrm

data.description: An enormous snake-like creature that thankfully only lives very far underground. Some say its very gaze causes even the bravest to flee.
data.name: Ungrow

data.description: Yet another reason to lock the doors and gather by the fireplace in large groups. Avoid the moors at midnight if you value your sanity.
data.name: Unseelie Wicht

data.description: Kevardhu fights with his bare hands. He hates for anything to get between him and his screaming victim.
data.name: Kevardhu

data.description: When the Runics scattered the Orcs and pacified the eastern regions several Orc clans refused to submit and hired themselves out as mercenaries.
data.name: Orc Warrior

data.description: An orc warrior of great martial ability. Generally a clan leader or champion.
data.name: Orc Lieutenant

data.description: When the Runics scattered the Orcs and pacified the eastern regions several Orc clans refused to submit and hired themselves out as mercenaries.
data.name: Orc Archer

data.description: Also known as Hyena-men. Powerful semi-civilised humanoids with vulpine features. Tend to dwell in mountainous areas and live off raiding their neighbours.
data.name: Gnoll

data.description: A giant brute among Gnolls. Battle Chief of the Stone Fist Clan. Keeps his position by cracking the heads of those who would disagree with him.
data.name: Gnoll Clan Leader

data.description: Representative of the Gnoll Stone Fist clan of the Grey Mountains. His presence here does not bode well for peace in Karnak.
data.name: Gnoll Envoy

data.description: A mighty warrior of the Stone Fist clan of Gnolls.
data.name: Gnoll Captain

data.description: Proud Sidhe warriors. Closely related to Grey Elves.
data.name: Fir'bolg Warrior

data.description: Nguthzg is a lava demon from the plane of Fire. He has been summoned against his will by the Demonologist Darvik and bound to his service. He appears to lead the Seven.
data.name: Nguthzg the Charred

data.description: Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine yew wood shafts.
data.name: Fir'bolg Archer

data.description: Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine yew wood shafts.
data.name: Fir'bolg Archer

data.description: Karnak women fight alongside their men, matching them in prowess and often surpassing them in drinking ability.
data.name: Karnak Armswoman

data.description: Mischievous winged imps, these creatures tend to live in wells and crave shiny objects. Rumours of their granting wishes are greatly exaggerated.
data.name: Korrigan

data.description: This evil semi-vampiric race was thankfully wiped out at the hands of the Firbolg-Danaan alliance a hundred years ago.
data.name: Shadowgaunt

data.description: Guttur was the mightiest and cruelest of the Laerg enforcers. It is unclear why he left the Laerg homeland and took up with those not of his kind
data.name: Guttur

data.description: 'The Lord of the Mound.' A beast thought to be the physical manifestation of fey moor spirits.
data.name: Cenn Cruaich

data.description: Unnatural creatures spawned from the bowels of moors, fells and swamps.
data.name: Fellspawn

spells: Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: Red Claws, also referred to as Blood Furs. Known for their bounding attacks: the beast leaps over its victim and attacks them from behind, causing entanglement.
data.name: Dergan Craw

data.description: Generations of breeding large mastiffs with wolves has resulted in a fearsome guard dog.
data.name: Warhound

data.description: Crafted during the Battle of Mages in days long forgotten. Highly resistant to magic these slow but sturdy constructs animate at a predetermined trigger.
data.name: Dweomer Golem

data.description: Selkie's in seal form are slow but have a powerful bite and layers of blubber make them impervious to cold.
data.name: Selkie

data.description: A cunning soldier, Garanhir leads a company of Nordman mercenaries. He was probably lured down from the northern fasts with the hope of plunder and pillage.
data.name: Garanhir

data.description: Alder Ent of the Boscawen Copse. A race of long lived forest warders.
data.name: Alder Ent

data.description: Magical experimentation with fungi resulted in this shambling creature.
data.name: Animated Toadstool

data.description: The essence of anti-life.
data.name: Shade

data.description: An enormous crab with a carapace as thick as plate mail. Razor sharp pincers snap at those foolish enough to get within range of it. Only blunt weapons can crack its shell.
data.name: Rock Legest

data.description: Also known as the Lyryon Gwragh, 'Flood Hag'. Banished from the Ocean for her cruelty. She is formed of living water. Only the sharpest blade will cut her tide.
data.name: Loireag

data.description: An large crab with a carapace as thick as chain mail. Razor sharp pincers snap at those foolish enough to get within range of it. Only blunt weapons can crack its shell.
data.name: Dune Legest

data.description: Cunning water spirits who take the form of fierce waves when threatened. They pummel their opponents with watery slaps as hard as stone and cold as death.
data.name: Gwartheg

data.description: Also known as Sharkmen. These aggressive cold-blooded humanoids generally live in coastal waters or along rocky shorelines.
data.name: Greater Reef Grimal

data.description: Talk of the taverns is that Terksch was exiled from his native troll homeland for acts so despicable that even trolls wouldn't stomach them.
data.name: Terksch

data.description: Also known as Sharkmen. These aggressive cold-blooded humanoids generally live in coastal waters or along rocky shorelines.
data.name: Reef Grimal

data.description: A demon lord who prefers to trap souls through cruel manipulation rather than brute force. Some demons mock his 'gentle' ways, but none can fault his success.
data.name: Child of Night

data.description: Raised through means never spoken of by the Druids. These thick necked  creatures exude a pungent smell and deliver punishing blows with their thorny fists.
data.name: Peat Golem

data.description: Lesser Daemon from a plane of pure electrical energy.
data.name: Mantic

data.description: Daemon from a plane of pure electrical energy.
data.name: Greater Mantic

data.description: Mantic overlord. A daemon of great cunning who has taken advantage of this opportunity to feed off the life essence of his mortal victims.
data.name: Hr'zzz'tt the Overlord

data.description: Former Prelate of the Grey God. Given the dubious gift of unlife by his Lord to continue his service following his demise at the hands of Diarmait Ua Duibne.
data.name: Clur'can Thrice Damned

spells: Classic Major Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: In life, a formerly valiant warrior. Now a walking nightmare.
data.name: Skeletal Warrior

data.description: Mercenaries hailing from the rugged mountains to the north. A hardy and coarse race respecting martial ability above all else.
data.name: Nordman Mercenary

data.description: 'Full of Anger'.  The Nameless One's most devoted priests underwent a horrific transformation to serve Him in His next incarnation. They lie dormant until His summoning ...
data.name: Angreden

data.description: Heroes from a bygone age, raised from death and enslaved.
data.name: Grey Archon, Vambrace

data.description: Heroes from a bygone age, raised from death and enslaved.
data.name: Grey Archon, Sabaton

data.description: Heroes from a bygone age, raised from death and enslaved.
data.name: Grey Archon, Pauldron

data.description: A forsaken hero from a bygone age, raised from death and enslaved.
data.name: Grey Archon, Gorget

data.description: A bard of considerable talent. Known locally as a 'droll' the Karnak name for bards. Welcomed everywhere for their revered story telling abilities. Keepers of oral history.
data.name: Llywarch

data.description: A cut above the typical hired sword. Only the wealthiest of merchants are able to afford these solid mercenaries.
data.name: Elite Merchant Guard

data.description: Followers of Baille, these misguided novices once studied under true druids until they were approached by Baille and convinced that his path was the one to tread.
data.name: Druid Novice

data.description: A high priest of the Grey God, whose name cannot be uttered. The true leader of the Seven, a fact known only to himself, Darvik, Nguthzg and now yourself.
data.name: Seiran the Joykiller

data.description: 'Tree wight'. In happier times, an Alder Ent of the Llengelly Copse. Now raised from death and enslaved.
data.name: Gwydhaenn Wiht

data.description: It is unheard of for a druid to walk the dark paths and use his knowledge against the natural world. Sadly, Baille has walked far from the light of Arn toward the darkness.
data.name: Baille, the Dark Druid

spells: Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: Used by wizards to protect their belongings, the magically animated Gargoyle is enchanted to attack unless the correct word or gesture is given.
data.name: Glyph Gargoyle

data.description: Finest of the Fir'bolg rangers. Gwydion is a valiant but reckless archer.
data.name: Gwydion

data.description: Noone has heard much of this deadly heroine in recent times. Rumoured to have taken up work for the Thane of Porthenys.
data.name: Vesta

data.description: This Karnak brawler has been banned from almost every drinking establishment in the land. Buy him a drink and you will find out why.
data.name: Beleg of the Bludgeon

data.description: 'Razor Fish.' Large and aggressive fish. They employ a vicious bite to rip their prey to bloody ribbons.
data.name: Keligan

data.description: 'Bad Luck.' The local fishermen have long held that the mere sight of these monstrous fish brings terrible luck.
data.name: Hager Dowl

data.description: Generally docile and lethargic, these squat lizards give a nasty bite to anyone wandering too close to their lairs.
data.name: Cave Lizard

data.description: Attack with a fierce shriek of ultra high sonic energy which can cause confusion.
data.name: Shadow Bat

data.description: Forest dwelling toads, known for leaping from nearby trees to pounce upon victims and deliver a bite laden with corrosive juices.
data.name: Tree Toad

data.description: Subterranean worms, so named because of their bright scales. A highly toxic poison is delivered from their powerful jaws.
data.name: Amethyst Worm

data.description: Tiny, cobra like serpents whose venom strikes at the optic nerve.
data.name: Steel Coil

data.description: 'Evil ones.' These trolls rarely venture far from their cave homes, as most non-trolls will attack them on sight. Such is their reputation for cruelty.
data.name: Tebelyons

data.description: 'Dark Goblin.' Despite their name they are in fact smaller relatives of trolls. They often live in cooperation with their larger and stupider neighbours.
data.name: Bucca Du

data.description: Huge claws and mandibles, designed for tunneling through rock, make quick work of opponents. Beware the eyes, which can cause confusion.
data.name: Umber Hulk

data.description: A dangerous opponent that enjoys swooping down on its prey and mauling them with razor sharp hooves and a wicked beak.
data.name: Griffon, Female

data.description: A demon who has failed to harvest a sufficient number of souls to enter the demon aristocracy. A foul and depraved killer.
data.name: Night Demon

data.description: Hideous demons, covered in wicked barbs, salivating corrosive bile from their revolting mouths. They are covered in weeping sores and dead peeling flesh.
data.name: Monguras

data.description: 'Dog Brother.' These large canine featured humanoids are said to dwell in the mountains to the east.
data.name: Ky Broder

data.description: 'Yrimthursar' in their own tongue meaning 'Sons of Ymir' their icy god. A giant race of humanoids native to the frozen north.
data.name: Frost Giant

data.description: Grey coloured arachnid of tremendous cunning and power.  Huge size and a poisonous bite combine to present a deadly creature.
data.name: Grey Death

data.description: 'Guardian.' Raised from the field of battle and given unlife, these shambling and disease-ridden creatures hunger for the living.
data.name: Vartha

data.description: This ungainly but highly efficient killing machine has provided heavy artillery support to Runic campaigns throughout the continent.
data.name: Runic Cheiroballista

data.description: 'Watcher.'
data.name: Euryor

data.description: 'Protector.'
data.name: Difresyas

data.description: 'Sword Hound.'
data.name: Kledharech

data.description: 'Curse.'
data.name: Molleth

data.description: 'The Raven.'
data.name: Marghvran

data.description: 'Marauder.'
data.name: Ravner

data.description: 'Growler.'
data.name: Grondin

data.description: Very aggressive and territorial spider. Often hunts in packs. Large but not very fast and thankfully not thought to have a venomous bite.
data.name: Northern Spider

data.description: Large fat spiders that dwell in thick forests. Masters at using their environment to trap the unwary in webs. A bite that can cause paralysis.
data.name: Forest Spider

data.description: Almost invisible against the backdrop of their native icy home, these large and aggressive nomads wander the snowy north in search of easy prey.
data.name: Frost Goblin

data.description: As beautiful as it is deadly, the fabled unicorn can make lightning fast attacks with its single horn, causing blindness if it strikes the eyes.
data.name: Unicorn

data.description: The females of this long forgotten race have mastered basic magic to complement their fierce physical attacks.
data.name: Primalian Female

data.description: A mighty neanderthal being, distantly related to humankind. Powerfully muscled and armed with massive stone hammers and rocks.
data.name: Primalian Male

data.description: The Nordmen speak of a giant serpent that lives beneath the ice floes. It preys upon anything foolish enough to venture out onto the ice. The Nordmen are full of such fables.
data.name: Ice Serpent

data.description: 'Stone Nest.' So named because of the enormous rocky lairs these monstrous wyms create along the sea cliffs.
data.name: Meyn Neth

data.description: Warped by the vile magics of Laerg shamans at the orders of their Dragon overlord, the Draco-Laerg is a mixed breed of Laerg and dragon.
data.name: Draco-Laerg

data.description: Laerg domesticated beast. These walking reptiles are incredibly fast and have a venomous bite.
data.name: Laerg Gnawer

data.description: Laerg domesticated beast. An enormous reptile used as a shock troop. Few enemy lines can withstands its frantic charge.
data.name: Laerg Charger

data.description: The High Shaman is second in power only to the great Wyrm. He rules with an iron fist over the other shamen who in turn rule the Laerg.
data.name: Laerg High Shaman

data.description: The Laerg shamen draw upon the powers granted to them by their reptilian god.
data.name: Laerg Shaman

data.description: Very little is known about this ancient reptilian race of cave dwellers.
data.name: Laerg

data.description: It is said that young Laerg that manifest the correct tendencies towards size and aggression are streamed into a secret regimen. This is the result.
data.name: Laerg Enforcer

data.description: Powerfully built beasts native to the frozen north. Often dwelling in caves in small families or packs they rarely seek trouble with others but will attack any who enter their caves.
data.name: Yeti

data.description: It is whispered that these vicious wights are souls who have been caught in limbo, unable to proceed to an afterlife due to some curse or other intervention.
data.name: Barrow Wicht

data.description: A foul spirit known to roam the scarred landscapes of ancient battlefields and other places of mass killings.
data.name: Feaster of Souls

data.description: These magnificent beasts have roamed the forests of Karnak for as long as recorded history. Venerated by the locals, their image is often used on heraldic devices.
data.name: Wild Boar

data.description: Not an overtly aggressive creature, the giant badger is however fiercely territorial and will attack without quarter anyone approaching its warren or young.
data.name: Giant Badger

data.description: A snake of unbelievable size.  Easily  60 feet in length and as large around as a full-grown bull vusk.
data.name: Mammoth Snake

data.description: A large striped and heavily furred cat with a mean temper and the fangs to back it up.
data.name: Great Mountain Cat

data.description: A large wolf whose very howl is said to cause fear. Probably just the excuse of fools who run when confronted with a dog in the shadows.
data.name: Dire Wolf

data.description: A large mountain cat with razor sharp jaws.
data.name: Cougar

data.description: A proud and rarely met denizen of the forests and plains. Totally unwilling to mix with humankind. As a result they are thought to be legend.
data.name: Centaur

data.description: Many have heard tales of the Wild Hunt: of forests oddly depopulated; of an oddly compelling horn which sounds in the depths of forests far from civilization.
data.name: Cernunnos the Hunter

data.description: Malicious forest dwellers. They delight in torturing travellers with their cruel sense of humour.
data.name: Quickling

data.description: A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
data.name: Giant Snake

data.description: Knight-Marshal of the Danaan Riders. Blessed in the eyes of Macha, Goddess of Battle. Lost in the Great War a hundred years ago.
data.name: Diarmait Ua Duibne

data.description: Rider of the Tuatha de Danaan. An ancient order of Sidhe knights sworn to protect the sacred forest shrine of Slieve Fuad. Now just a footnote in history.
data.name: Danaan Rider

data.description: Rumoured to be the sole surviving Rider of the Tuatha de Nanann. Changed his name to Cup Seeker (Per Dur in the old tongue) due to his hopeless quest.
data.name: Peredur

data.description: Militia from the town of Pengelly.
data.name: Pengelly Bowman

data.description: Militia from the town of Pengelly.
data.name: Pengelly Man at Arms

data.description: Gwaf,  the Winter Dragon.
data.name: Gwaf

data.description: 'Sword-bearer'. The Thane of Porthenys.
data.name: Seaxneat of Porthenys

data.description: Petty footpads making nuisances of themselves in the low hills east of Porthenys.
data.name: Scum

data.description: Has risen to the questionable position of leading the Scum in their less than daring raids on unarmed merchants and civilians around Porthenys.
data.name: Scum Leader, Tain

data.description: Smaller but with more cunning and guile than their larger cousins who they tend to manipulate.
data.name: Boggart

data.description: Considered a mighty hunter by Knockerkin standards.
data.name: Welk the Mighty

data.description: A secretive mountain race. Very fast and agile. They are known for both their cunning traps and pelting unwanted intruders with relentless barrages of darts.
data.name: Groat

data.description: These minor demons live their often short brutal lives as servants to those more powerful than themselves.
data.name: Flame Demon

data.description: These blind subterranean river serpents have never seen the light of day. They hunt by following the water disturbances made by their prey.
data.name: Core serpent

data.description: A flightless dragon from the deepest depths of the earth. A true horror about which very little is known.
data.name: Earth Dragon

data.description: Young earth dragons. Probably best to dispatch them before they grow to full size.
data.name: Young Earth Dragon

data.description: A dangerous opponent that enjoys swooping down on its prey and mauling them with razor sharp hooves and a wicked beak.
data.name: Griffon, Male

data.description: River dwelling fey equines with manes of seaweed. From a distance they resemble horses, but they are ferocious flesh eaters.
data.name: Kelpie

data.description: Tales abound of these bizarre creatures. They spring from the forest floor to snare the unwary, utilising their near perfect camouflage.
data.name: Autumnal Creeper

data.description: These walking (or rather stumbling) dead are said to haunt the area where they met an untimely end.
data.name: Restless Dead

data.description: Name says it all. They prefer to sneak up on their prey unawares, preferably with a poisoned blade. Cowardly backstabbers.
data.name: Thief

data.description: Gibber travelled with Terksh into exile. A more cowardly and cruel specimen of trolldom is hard to imagine. He delights in torture and pain.
data.name: Gibber

data.description: Men at arms for hire. Freebooters who turn coat to the highest bidder.
data.name: Mercenary

data.description: These guys rule the pits - too bad the place isn't worth anything.
data.name: Pit Gangmember

data.description: The Avatar is protected by an aura of invulnerability.
data.name: Grey God's Avatar

data.description: Also known as Satyrs. Bestial men with the legs of fauns and small horns. Particularly aggressive during rutting season. Attack with punchs and a vicious head butt.
data.name: Urisk

data.description: Well armed and trained mercenary in the employ of the Silverband.
data.name: Silverband Enforcer

data.description: Failed pirates who have turned to luring ships onto reefs to plunder them.
data.name: Wrecker

data.description: Town militia of Ryn. Light infantry, armed with spear and shield. Untested troops; who knows what would happen if they saw action.
data.name: Ryn Infantry

data.description: A Necromancer and Demonologist of considerable learning. Some say he is either hopelessly insane or possessed. He is rumoured to be in these parts.
data.name: Darvik the Damned

data.description: Master strategist and former comrade-in-arms of Lord Godolphin. Present whereabouts unknown.
data.name: Penhaligon

data.description: Cairbre, the eldest son of Lord Godolphin, is a celebrated warrior among the Karnak people.
data.name: Cairbre Godolphin

data.description: Lord Godolphin has maintained control of his modest fiefdom through a combination of political cunning and martial skills.
data.name: Lord Godolphin

data.description: Lightly armoured and hefting a vicious war axe, Karnak armsmen are not professional soldiers but rather ordinary townsfolk long used to defending their homesteads.
data.name: Karnak Armsman

data.description: A cut above the typical Karnak armsman. These Karnak warriors inspire their troops through sheer courage and savagery.
data.name: Karnak Veteran

data.description: Basic Runic troop armed with halberd and shield. Superb training and discipline has allowed Runic Legions to dominate the continent.
data.name: Runic Legionnaire

data.description: Runic squad leaders have been promoted from the lesser ranks. Loud mouthed bully-boys who keep the lower ranks in line.
data.name: Runic Squad Leader

data.description: Years of training at the Runic academy of martial arts combined with countless campaigns make this Runic warrior a deadly foe.
data.name: Runic Warlord

data.description: Light troops armed with sword and crossbow.
data.name: Runic Auxiliary

data.description: Prefects make up the Watch of a Runic city, keeping order through a judicious mix of diplomacy and heavy blunt instruments.
data.name: Runic Prefect
